purpose: Development test of group-conditioned soft temporal fusion with a shared newest joint intent.

offline_prior.constraint: H_temp is analysis-only and is never used by the executor.

coordination.sol_repaired_rollout_requirement: Sol's repaired h16 trio is complete. Any group-memory rollout remains separately gated and must construct a fresh environment for each condition/state using exactly identical task/state/environment seed settings.
coordination.rollout_gate: The Sol trio and shared kernel are recorded, but this coordination notification does not launch or authorize a group-memory rollout. Before any later launch, preserve fresh-env pairing and pass the strict per-policy common-prefix smoke.

cohort.selection: Existing exposed development cohort; no performance-based task or state selection.

cohort_task_specs.task_name: pick up the bbq sauce and place it in the basket
pick up the black bowl between the plate and the ramekin and place it on the plate
put the wine bottle on top of the cabinet
put the black bowl in the bottom drawer of the cabinet and close it

policy.query_schedule: q=0,16,32,...; exactly one policy query at each scheduled physical step

policy_rng.smolvla_rule: key by policy, task, state, environment seed, and physical query step q; method-independent

shared_kernel.candidate_order: oldest source query to newest source query
shared_kernel.dense_equivalent_te: b_q proportional to exp(-0.01 * (q-q_oldest)) for the oldest-to-newest sparse candidate list; at h16 this is [1,e^-0.16,e^-0.32,...]
shared_kernel.candidate_index_te: b_i proportional to exp(-0.01 * i), i=0 for oldest candidate
shared_kernel.selection_rule: Use exactly Sol's final semantic decision; do not independently choose a kernel. Sol selected dense_equivalent_te; the repaired h16 trio is recorded above.

candidate_pool.rule: All sparse-query chunks whose same-target offset is nonnegative and smaller than H_pred; no extra query and no candidate-specific truncation beyond native horizon validity.
candidate_pool.same_target: candidate from source q is chunk[t-q], so q+(t-q)=t
candidate_pool.newest_candidate: The newest scheduled query q0<=t is always present; its physical age is t-q0 and is zero only when t=q0.
candidate_pool.candidate_set_must_be_identical: For a fixed trajectory, M0-M3 receive the same candidate rows, source queries, offsets, and ages.

M1_shared_te_h16.description: One Sol-selected shared temporal weight vector for all seven dimensions.

M2_shared_cogact_h16.equation: score_q=b_q * exp(0.3*cosine(a_{t|q},a_{t|q0})); normalize over q; one vector for all dimensions
M2_shared_cogact_h16.description: Existing CogACT-style whole-action compatibility with the Sol-selected shared temporal prior.

M3_group_cogact_h16.equation: score_g(q)=b_q * exp(0.3*c_g(q)); normalize independently by g
M3_group_cogact_h16.gripper_compatibility: sign(candidate[6]) * sign(newest[6]); same sign +1, opposite sign -1, zero with nonzero 0, zero with zero 0.
M3_group_cogact_h16.gripper_operator: Ordinary weighted average of the original scalar values; no sign vote.
M3_group_cogact_h16.description: Only the weight factorization changes relative to M2.

M4_anchored_group_reliability_h16.equation_if_enabled: score_g(q)=b_q * compatibility_g(q) * reliability_g(q); newest source receives fixed reliability 1; normalize by group
M4_anchored_group_reliability_h16.reason: The current checkout has no frozen online-compatible group reliability predictor/artifact. Historical source-context reliability is a different ACT cohort and its training artifact is not available as a runtime interface here.
M4_anchored_group_reliability_h16.two_clock_distinction: M4 would fuse all candidates softly around the newest joint anchor; it would not independently hard-select arm and gripper sources.

compatibility.zero_handling: Use the established np.sign product for the scalar gripper analogue.

pairing.validator: At least state 10/seed 2000 must show identical reset observations, processed policy inputs, initial simulator state, initial raw chunk, actions t=0..15, post-action simulator states, and post-action observations across all methods.
pairing.failure_action: Stop and do not launch the panel.

stage_1_act.m4: not scheduled unless a valid online reliability interface is added before freeze
stage_1_act.new_method_budget: M2-M3 up to 80 episodes; M4 up to 40 if available. M0/M1 may be reused only after Sol compatibility confirmation.

stage_2_smolvla.m4: best valid M4 only if available
stage_2_smolvla.budget: up to 80 episodes for new SmolVLA methods
stage_2_smolvla.gate: Do not start before ACT gate.

analysis.posthoc_H_temp: Load frozen H_temp only after all outcomes are frozen; Spearman, scatter, and qualitative counterexamples only. Never use it in the executor or method selection.
analysis.selection_rule: M3 if it clearly beats M2; M4 only if reliability adds meaningful benefit beyond M3; do not retain extra complexity for a one-episode difference.
